scripts.build:source: node tools/build-compendium-source.mjs && node tools/build-castes-journal.mjs && node tools/build-races-journal.mjs
scripts.pack:armes-armures: fvtt package pack -n armes-armures --inputDirectory packs-src/armes-armures --outputDirectory packs
scripts.pack:capacites: fvtt package pack -n capacites --inputDirectory packs-src/capacites --outputDirectory packs
scripts.pack:castes: fvtt package pack -n castes --inputDirectory packs-src/castes --outputDirectory packs
scripts.pack:personnages: fvtt package pack -n personnages --inputDirectory packs-src/personnages --outputDirectory packs
scripts.pack:races: fvtt package pack -n races --inputDirectory packs-src/races --outputDirectory packs
scripts.build:packs: npm run pack:armes-armures && npm run pack:capacites && npm run pack:castes && npm run pack:personnages && npm run pack:races
scripts.build:all: npm run build:source && npm run build:packs
